title: Homograph & Phishing URL Detection
description: Machine learning system for detecting legitimate, phishing, and homograph attack URLs. The project uses advanced feature engineering such as entropy, punycode detection, script mixing, and statistical URL analysis combined with models like Logistic Regression, Random Forest, XGBoost, and CatBoost.

title: D’Classics Books
description: D’Classics Books is a mobile application designed in Figma and implemented using Android Studio prototype concepts. It provides a curated platform for classic literature enthusiasts to browse, purchase, and manage books. The app includes login authentication flow, home dashboard with featured books and carousel store previews, categorized book listings, detailed book ordering system with validation, and store directory navigation.

title: Fanbot - WhatsApp Automation Bot
description: Fanbot is a WhatsApp automation bot built using Node.js and Baileys library. It supports real-time messaging, automatic reply handling, pairing code authentication, and smart response logic based on time conditions (e.g., sleep mode auto-reply).

title: SONGIFY: Music Recommendation System
description: A content-based music recommendation system built with Python using Cosine Similarity to recommend songs based on their feature similarity. The project includes data preprocessing, feature engineering, similarity matrix generation, and personalized music recommendations for users.
